title: The Story of Nanjing’s Mochou Lake (1)
synopsis: Learn about the origin story of Mochou Lake in Nanjing, China.

fullText.simplified:
南京莫愁湖的故事（一）

    在中国南京，有一个非常著名的景点——莫愁湖，向来都有“江南第一名湖”、“金陵第一名胜”的美称。要说莫愁湖的名字，就要从古代有个名叫莫愁的女孩说起。
    莫愁出生在古代一户农家，因为是秋天所生，所以叫做秋女。她的父亲不仅善于种地，而且是个医生。在秋女14岁的时候，父亲上山采药，出了意外，不幸身亡。
    秋女为了凑钱葬父，毅然选择了卖身。她感叹自己的未来一片迷茫，不禁发愁起来，于是在卖身牌上给自己的“秋”字加上了一个“心”字，便成了愁女。
    有个叫卢二的商人，把她买了下来，认她做干女儿，并给了她一个新名字，叫“莫愁”。卢二给她买新衣服，梳妆打扮，打扮后的莫愁变成了个大美人。卢二把莫愁卖到了青楼，赚了一大笔钱后就逃走了。
    莫愁自认命苦，不哭不闹。老板见到她聪明伶俐，就请了几个老师教她写诗、作词、唱歌、跳舞。一年后，莫愁成了店里的头牌。老板叫她接待客人，莫愁坚守“只卖艺不卖身”的原则，所以莫愁一直保持着清白之身。
    卢二的堂兄卢员外，在发愁自己的儿子一直没有结婚，很想给儿子找一个老婆。有一天，卢二在老板那里打听到莫愁还是清白之身，而且比以前更加漂亮了，就想把莫愁介绍给卢公子。
    那么，莫愁和卢公子能结婚吗？卢公子的家人会同意吗？请看下回分解。
fullText.traditional:
南京莫愁湖的故事（一）

    在中國南京，有一個非常著名的景點——莫愁湖，向來都有“江南第一名湖”、“金陵第一名勝”的美稱。要說莫愁湖的名字，就要從古代有個名叫莫愁的女孩說起。
    莫愁出生在古代一戶農家，因為是秋天所生，所以叫做秋女。她的父親不僅善於種地，而且是個醫生。在秋女14歲的時候，父親上山採藥，出了意外，不幸身亡。
    秋女為了湊錢葬父，毅然選擇了賣身。她感嘆自己的未來一片迷茫，不禁發愁起來，於是在賣身牌上給自己的“秋”字加上了一個“心”字，便成了愁女。
    有個叫盧二的商人，把她買了下來，認她做乾女兒，並給了她一個新名字，叫“莫愁”。盧二給她買新衣服，梳妝打扮，打扮後的莫愁變成了個大美人。盧二把莫愁賣到了青樓，賺了一大筆錢後就逃走了。
    莫愁自認命苦，不哭不鬧。老闆見到她聰明伶俐，就請了幾個老師教她寫詩、作詞、唱歌、跳舞。一年後，莫愁成了店裡的頭牌。老闆叫她接待客人，莫愁堅守“只賣藝不賣身”的原則，所以莫愁一直保持著清白之身。
    盧二的堂兄盧員外，在發愁自己的兒子一直沒有結婚，很想給兒子找一個老婆。有一天，盧二在老闆那裡打聽到莫愁還是清白之身，而且比以前更加漂亮了，就想把莫愁介紹給盧公子。
    那麼，莫愁和盧公子能結婚嗎？盧公子的家人會同意嗎？請看下回分解。

sentences.english: In Nanjing, China, there is a very famous landmark — Mochou Lake.

sentences.traditional: 要說莫愁湖的名字，就要從古代有個名叫莫愁的女孩說起。

sentences.english: It has long been praised as “Jiangnan’s most renowned lake” and “Jinling’s most renowned scenic spot”.
When talking about Mochou Lake’s name, we need to begin with a girl from ancient China named Mochou.

sentences.simplified: 莫愁出生在古代一户农家，因为是秋天所生，所以叫做秋女。
sentences.traditional: 莫愁出生在古代一戶農家，因為是秋天所生，所以叫做秋女。

sentences.pinyin: tā de fù qīn bù jǐn shàn yú zhòng dì ér qiě shì ge yī shēng
sentences.english: Mochou was born into a peasant family in ancient China. Because she was born in the autumn, she was named Qiunü.

sentences.simplified: 在秋女14岁的时候，父亲上山采药，
sentences.traditional: 在秋女14歲的時候，父親上山採藥，
sentences.pinyin: zài qiū nǚ 2 suì de shí hou fù qīn shàng shān cǎi yào
sentences.english: Her father was not only skilled at farming; he was also a doctor.

sentences.simplified: 出了意外，不幸身亡。
sentences.traditional: 出了意外，不幸身亡。
sentences.pinyin: chū le yì wài bú xìng shēn wáng
sentences.english: When Qiunü was 14 years old, her father went into the mountains to gather medicine.
An accident occurred, and unfortunately he passed away.

sentences.simplified: 秋女为了凑钱葬父，毅然选择了卖身。
sentences.traditional: 秋女為了湊錢葬父，毅然選擇了賣身。
sentences.pinyin: qiū nǚ wèi le còu qián zàng fù yì rán xuǎn zé le mài shēn

sentences.simplified: 她感叹自己的未来一片迷茫，不禁发愁起来，
sentences.traditional: 她感嘆自己的未來一片迷茫，不禁發愁起來，
sentences.pinyin: tā gǎn tàn zì jǐ de wèi lái yí piàn mí máng bù jīn fā chóu qǐ lái
sentences.english: In order to raise money for her father’s burial, Qiunü resolved to sell herself.

sentences.simplified: 于是在卖身牌上给自己的“秋”字加上了一个“心”字，便成了愁女。
sentences.traditional: 於是在賣身牌上給自己的“秋”字加上了一個“心”字，便成了愁女。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì zài mài shēn pái shang gěi zì jǐ de qiū zì jiā shàng le yí ge xīn zì biàn chéng le chóu nǚ
sentences.english: She lamented that her future was completely unknown. She couldn’t help but feel anxious.
So, on her nameplate, she added the character for “heart” underneath the character for “autumn” in her name and became Chounü.

sentences.simplified: 有个叫卢二的商人，把她买了下来，认她做干女儿，
sentences.traditional: 有個叫盧二的商人，把她買了下來，認她做乾女兒，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu ge jiào lú èr de shāng rén bǎ tā mǎi le xià lai rèn tā zuò gān nǚ ér

sentences.simplified: 并给了她一个新名字，叫“莫愁”。
sentences.traditional: 並給了她一個新名字，叫“莫愁”。
sentences.pinyin: bìng gěi le tā yí ge xīn míng zi jiào mò chóu
sentences.english: A merchant named Lu Er bought her and made her his adopted daughter.

sentences.simplified: 卢二给她买新衣服，梳妆打扮，打扮后的莫愁变成了个大美人。
sentences.traditional: 盧二給她買新衣服，梳妝打扮，打扮後的莫愁變成了個大美人。
sentences.pinyin: lú èr gěi tā mǎi xīn yī fu shū zhuāng dǎ ban dǎ ban hòu de mò chóu biàn chéng le ge dà měi rén
sentences.english: He gave her a new name, “Mochou” (“do not worry”).

sentences.simplified: 卢二把莫愁卖到了青楼，赚了一大笔钱后就逃走了。
sentences.traditional: 盧二把莫愁賣到了青樓，賺了一大筆錢後就逃走了。
sentences.pinyin: lú èr bǎ mò chóu mài dào le qīng lóu zhuàn le yí dà bǐ qián hòu jiù táo zǒu le
sentences.english: Lu Er bought her new clothes and dressed her up. Afterward, Mochou became a very beautiful woman.
Lu Er then sold Mochou to a brothel, earning a lot of money, and ran away.

sentences.simplified: 莫愁自认命苦，不哭不闹。
sentences.traditional: 莫愁自認命苦，不哭不鬧。
sentences.pinyin: mò chóu zì rèn mìng kǔ bù kū bú nào

sentences.simplified: 老板见到她聪明伶俐，
sentences.traditional: 老闆見到她聰明伶俐，
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn jiàn dào tā cōng ming líng lì
sentences.english: Mochou accepted her cruel fate and did not cry or make a fuss.

sentences.simplified: 就请了几个老师教她写诗、作词、唱歌、跳舞。
sentences.traditional: 就請了幾個老師教她寫詩、作詞、唱歌、跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: jiù qǐng le jǐ ge lǎo shī jiāo tā xiě shī zuò cí chàng gē tiào wǔ
sentences.english: The boss saw that she was clever and quick-witted, ..

sentences.simplified: 一年后，莫愁成了店里的头牌。
sentences.traditional: 一年後，莫愁成了店裡的頭牌。
sentences.pinyin: yì nián hòu mò chóu chéng le diàn lǐ de tóu pái
sentences.english: ..  so he hired teachers to teach her how to write poems, compose verses, sing, and dance.

sentences.simplified: 老板叫她接待客人，
sentences.traditional: 老闆叫她接待客人，
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bǎn jiào tā jiē dài kè rén
sentences.english: One year later, Mochou became the star performer of the brothel.

sentences.simplified: 莫愁坚守“只卖艺不卖身”的原则，所以莫愁一直保持着清白之身。
sentences.traditional: 莫愁堅守“只賣藝不賣身”的原則，所以莫愁一直保持著清白之身。
sentences.pinyin: mò chóu jiān shǒu zhǐ mài yì bú mài shēn de yuán zé suǒ yǐ mò chóu yì zhí bǎo chí zhe qīng bái zhī shēn
sentences.english: The boss asked her to receive guests, ..
.. and since Mochou upheld the principle of “selling her talent and not her body”, she remained a virgin.

sentences.simplified: 卢二的堂兄卢员外，在发愁自己的儿子一直没有结婚，很想给儿子找一个老婆。
sentences.traditional: 盧二的堂兄盧員外，在發愁自己的兒子一直沒有結婚，很想給兒子找一個老婆。
sentences.pinyin: lú èr de táng xiōng lú yuán wài zài fā chóu zì jǐ de ér zi yì zhí méi yǒu jié hūn hěn xiǎng gěi ér zi zhǎo yí ge lǎo po

sentences.simplified: 有一天，卢二在老板那里打听到莫愁还是清白之身，而且比以前更加漂亮了，
sentences.traditional: 有一天，盧二在老闆那裡打聽到莫愁還是清白之身，而且比以前更加漂亮了，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān lú èr zài lǎo bǎn nà lǐ dǎ ting dào mò chóu hái shì qīng bái zhī shēn ér qiě bǐ yǐ qián gèng jiā piào liang le
sentences.english: Lu Er’s older cousin, Counselor Lu, worried that his son had not yet married, and wanted to find his son a wife.

sentences.simplified: 就想把莫愁介绍给卢公子。
sentences.traditional: 就想把莫愁介紹給盧公子。
sentences.pinyin: jiù xiǎng bǎ mò chóu jiè shào gěi lú gōng zǐ
sentences.english: One day, Lu Er had heard from the boss that Mouchou was still a virgin, and she was even more beautiful than before.
Hence, he wanted to introduce Mochou to the son of Counselor Lu.

sentences.simplified: 那么，莫愁和卢公子能结婚吗？
sentences.traditional: 那麼，莫愁和盧公子能結婚嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nà me mò chóu hé lú gōng zǐ néng jié hūn ma

sentences.simplified: 卢公子的家人会同意吗？请看下回分解。
sentences.traditional: 盧公子的家人會同意嗎？請看下回分解。
sentences.pinyin: lú gōng zǐ de jiā rén huì tóng yì ma qǐng kàn xià huí fēn jiě
sentences.english: So, did Mo Chou and the son of Counselor Lu end up getting married?
Did the family members of the son of Counselor Lu agree? To find out, please read the next part.

raw.synopsis: Learn about the origin story of Mochou Lake in Nanjing, China.
sentence_translations: The Story of Nanjing’s Mochou Lake (Part 1)
In Nanjing, China, there is a very famous landmark — Mochou Lake.
It has long been praised as “Jiangnan’s most renowned lake” and “Jinling’s most renowned scenic spot”.
When talking about Mochou Lake’s name, we need to begin with a girl from ancient China named Mochou.
Mochou was born into a peasant family in ancient China. Because she was born in the autumn, she was named Qiunü.
Her father was not only skilled at farming; he was also a doctor.
When Qiunü was 14 years old, her father went into the mountains to gather medicine.
An accident occurred, and unfortunately he passed away.
In order to raise money for her father’s burial, Qiunü resolved to sell herself.
She lamented that her future was completely unknown. She couldn’t help but feel anxious.
So, on her nameplate, she added the character for “heart” underneath the character for “autumn” in her name and became Chounü.
A merchant named Lu Er bought her and made her his adopted daughter.
He gave her a new name, “Mochou” (“do not worry”).
Lu Er bought her new clothes and dressed her up. Afterward, Mochou became a very beautiful woman.
Lu Er then sold Mochou to a brothel, earning a lot of money, and ran away.
Mochou accepted her cruel fate and did not cry or make a fuss.
The boss saw that she was clever and quick-witted, ..
..  so he hired teachers to teach her how to write poems, compose verses, sing, and dance.
One year later, Mochou became the star performer of the brothel.
The boss asked her to receive guests, ..
.. and since Mochou upheld the principle of “selling her talent and not her body”, she remained a virgin.
Lu Er’s older cousin, Counselor Lu, worried that his son had not yet married, and wanted to find his son a wife.
One day, Lu Er had heard from the boss that Mouchou was still a virgin, and she was even more beautiful than before.
Hence, he wanted to introduce Mochou to the son of Counselor Lu.
So, did Mo Chou and the son of Counselor Lu end up getting married?
Did the family members of the son of Counselor Lu agree? To find out, please read the next part.
